cases.prompt: Replace sleeps in a flaky concurrent Go test and design an oracle for cancellation and leaks.
A Go service burns CPU; capture and interpret a profile.
Test that two concurrent withdrawals cannot violate an account limit.
Fix the signed webhook decoder so the committed fuzz regression seeds never panic and valid framing remains deterministic.
forbidden_outcomes: Persists mutable state across fuzz calls

cases.prompt: Review a Go 1.26 test that wraps an asynchronous client in synctest.Test. The real TCP listener and its server goroutine are created before the bubble. Inside the bubble the test calls t.Parallel, starts the client, calls synctest.Wait expecting a five-second retry timer to fire, and then reads a shared result. The retry and test sleep for the same deadline; neither side is explicitly stopped. State what this test can and cannot prove and the smallest deterministic test contract; retain a separate real-network check when transport behavior matters.
expected_invariants: Uses the stable Go 1.25 or 1.26 synctest.Test API rather than the Go 1.24 experimental Run API
Explains that only the root and goroutines transitively started inside synctest.Test belong to its bubble
Explains that real network I/O and a server goroutine created outside the bubble are not durably blocked or made deterministic
Treats synctest.Wait as a quiescence barrier rather than a request to advance every future timer
Advances fake time to the intended deadline and then waits for resulting work before asserting
Avoids T.Run T.Parallel and T.Deadline on the testing.T passed inside the bubble
Creates any protocol fake within the bubble and terminates every owned goroutine before the root returns
Keeps real network or process semantics in a separate integration test when those semantics are the claim
Does not rely on a deterministic order for independent events scheduled at the same fake instant
forbidden_outcomes: Fixes the test by increasing real sleeps or adding polling retries
Claims synctest makes external TCP or preexisting goroutines deterministic
Uses Wait alone to fire a future timer
